name: RMIT Women in STEM Undergraduate Scholarship
summary: Up to $10,000 a year for women in RMIT STEM undergraduate degrees whose circumstances affect their study.
key: Up to $10,000 a year for up to three years. One offered.
who: Circumstances that affect your study, or from an RMIT priority group.
how: Apply direct to RMIT online (preferred) or through VTAC.

source.label: RMIT: Women in STEM Undergraduate Scholarship

evidence.quote: This scholarship provides up to $10,000 per year for up to three years.
